children.text: Participants
ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout, Charan Kumar, Pavan Kalyan, Revanth Babu Raavi
Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury
Key Takeaways
SEO best practices were emphasized by ensuring that stats are linked to authoritative sources and images contain minimal text for clarity in both documents and website pages.
The homepage revamp documentation, including reasons for changes and UI/UX optimizations, is to be consolidated in one master document for team-wide clarity.
A comprehensive keyword strategy is to be developed for technology pages (e.g., reactjs.net and .net) to optimize landing pages based on search volume and segment content accordingly.
Google Ads and Search Console access issues, particularly regarding the Sigma and Lendfoundry accounts, were discussed and require a follow-up to ensure correct setup and campaign alignment.
Future blog content will integrate existing case studies from the Sigma website to enhance interlinking opportunities and highlight real-world examples.
Action Items
Samarpith Rout
Review the keyword research sheet containing the list of top technologies and keywords; determine which keywords are strong enough and identify if any additional keywords are needed.
Ensure the fintech digital solutions page has the primary and secondary keyword search volumes updated on the relevant topic sheet.
Update the chatbot greeting on the digital lending solutions page to be page-specific, reducing general messaging to improve conversion.

Compile a consolidated list of technologies and their associated keywords by reviewing the dotnet and ReactJS pages, then develop a keyword strategy to decide if individual landing pages or content segments are needed.
Analyze the ecommerce vertical keywords by reviewing existing keyword data and identifying any new keyword opportunities for refining the related landing pages.
Integrate relevant Sigma website case studies (e.g. Salesforce, Beehive) into upcoming blog posts for enhanced interlinking.
Harsha Thota
Prepare an overview document explaining the rationale behind the HTML homepage revamp. Consolidate this document into the main master sheet and share it with the team.
to: Shiresha Madhury
Validate that statistics in blog posts are accompanied by proper authoritative links (preferably from research organizations) rather than linking to competitor websites.
Ensure that images used in blog content have minimal text (only headlines) to avoid clutter; optimize image design accordingly.
Shiresha Madhury: Share the document with Magesh for review and discussion.
Verify that the correct Lendfoundry Google Search Console property is being used; check indexing status and sitemap accessibility and resolve any discrepancies.
Share the marketing sync-up report (keyword and landing page analysis) with the team to ensure alignment on which keywords and landing pages to focus on.
Magesh R
Verify the status of the LLM TXT file for both the Sigma and Lendfoundry sites; check for any issues and report if any changes are needed.
Revanth Babu Raavi

Develop and finalize a 3‐month website optimization plan addressing technology landing pages (fintech, ecommerce, BI analytics, and product engineering services) to improve SEO performance and conversion.
Content Reviewed
Blog feedback included adding specific stat links with authoritative sources and detailed comments.
Homepage design was discussed with emphasis on minimal text in images and improved UI/UX layout.
Wireframe for the revamped homepage and accompanying reasons for change document were mentioned for consolidation.
Technology pages (e.g., reactjs.net) were reviewed to compile all tech stacks and optimize keyword strategy.
Target Keywords
Fifteen target keywords were added to the keyword research sheet for relevant pages.
Digital lending platform keyword was set as primary with a search volume of 1,000.
Ecommerce vertical keywords need review to determine if new or existing keywords are optimal.
Metrics
Pages from the Semrush report are ranking for low volume keywords, indicating poor keyword performance.
Google Ads campaigns are active only for loan origination and loan servicing software with two ad groups running.
SEO Recommendations
Ensure stat references in blogs include authoritative links and avoid linking to competitor sites.
Optimize image design by maintaining minimal text for clarity on both website and word documents.
Integrate higher volume keywords into each page as highlighted by Semrush and Google Search Console data.
Customize chatbot greetings based on the landing page to improve lead conversions.
Competitors
Avoid using external links that direct users to competitor websites.
Content Refresh Opportunities
Revamp the homepage with an updated HTML version and consolidate change rationale in one master document.
Refine technology pages (e.g., reactjs.net) to include an optimized keyword strategy and improved interlinking.
Refresh blogs by leveraging internal case studies from the Sigma website for stronger interlinking opportunities.
User Experience (UX) Improvements
Ensure images use minimal text with only headlines to avoid visual clutter on both word docs and website.
Tailor chatbot greetings on each landing page to be specific, reducing user resistance and improving funnel clarity.
Lead Generation Strategy
Implement basic SEO health checks and UI adjustments, such as placing a prominent CTA in the first fold, to enhance lead conversion.
Share a detailed lead generation strategy document for further brainstorming and refining of the approach.
